verdict.rationale: Gmail has a first-party RESTful API covering the core mailbox surface: messages, threads, labels, drafts, sending, filters, delegates, signatures and push notifications. Developers report it makes building on Gmail far easier than IMAP. But the evidence does not show API parity for UI features like snooze, undo send or the Gemini summarize/draft tools, and a developer notes that listing threads doesn't return their messages, which makes building a full client hard. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for snooze, undo send and Gemini AI features, an explicit UI-parity commitment, and an OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
